mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates strong economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day returns despite GDP growth, or GDP growth without positive returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns when unemployment rises, or no significant negative correlation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rises and interest rates increase, it may indicate economic stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive 60-day returns despite the interaction, or no significant negative correlation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining federal funds rate stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or no significant positive correlation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth indicates strong supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns despite INDPRO growth, or no significant positive correlation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above a certain threshold indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative 5-day returns when HOUST exceeds threshold, or no significant positive correlation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth combined with lower interest rates indicates strong demand and cheap borrowing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative 20-day returns despite the interaction, or no significant positive correlation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment with payroll growth indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns despite payroll growth, or no significant positive correlation (t-test p > 0.05).
